page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-48-lssd is a server instance from the c4n family configured with 48 dedicated vCPUs on the x86_64 architecture. It features 372.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 7.75 GB of RAM per core. The server does not include any GPUs. The local storage size is designated as None, though the storage type is specified as nvme ssd. There are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio of nearly 8 GB per core, this instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance without resource contention. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high resource density of memory relative to the vCPU count makes it suitable for workloads requiring large in-memory datasets without needing a proportional increase in compute cores. Appropriate workloads include memory-intensive databases, caching layers, large-scale data processing, and enterprise applications that demand substantial memory capacity.
